jobs.title: Public Safety/Security Shift Coordinator (Nights) at Houston Methodist Houston, TX
jobs.description:
Public Safety/Security Shift Coordinator (Nights) job at Houston Methodist. Houston, TX. At Houston Methodist, the Public Safety/Security Shift Coordinator position is responsible for assigned activities of the Public Safety/Security department. In addition to performing the duties and functions of Security Officer, this position provides assignments, leads investigations and reviews reports for accuracy and thoroughness, staff protection, traffic control assignments, and emergency response services. This position provides Public Safety/Security to patients, visitors, physicians, and employees. This position exercises sound judgment and is self-motivated to work with limited supervision. The Public Safety/Security Shift Coordinator position must be flexible to work shift assignments, which includes all shifts and weekends. This position utilizes camera and card access systems.

FLSA STATUS
Non-exempt

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION
  • High School diploma or equivalent education (examples include: GED, verification of homeschool equivalency, partial or full completion of post-secondary education, etc.)
  • Associate’s degree in criminal justice or related field preferred
EXPERIENCE
  • Two years security or related field experience
  • Healthcare experience preferred
LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
Required
  • Must have one of the following: • SECUR-N - Security Officer Non-Commissioned- State Licensure ◦ Submission of application within 14 days of hire date, and obtained within one year of employment • SECUR-C - Security Officer Commissioned - State Licensure ◦ Level 3 or Personal Protection Officer Level 4 licensure and
  • IAHSS - Certified Security Officer-Basic/Advanced/Supervisor (IAHSS) - International Association for Healthcare Security & Safety_PSV and
  • DL - Driver License - State Licensure - Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation_PSV must obtain in Texas and
  • NVCRISIS - Nonviolent Crisis Intervention or Instructor (CPI) - Crisis Prevention Institute
Preferred
  • BLS - Basic Life Support or Instructor (AHA)
SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  • Demonstrates the skills and competencies necessary to safely perform the assigned job, determined through on-going skills, competency assessments, and performance evaluations
  • Sufficient proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing the English language necessary to perform the essential functions of this job, especially with regard to activities impacting patient or employee safety or security
  • Ability to effectively communicate with patients, physicians, family members and co-workers in a manner consistent with a customer service focus and application of positive language principles
  • Must have the ability to multi task and function calmly in stressful situations
  • Must possess strong customer service skills
  • Proficient computer skills including, but not limited to, knowledge of Microsoft Office software and Webmail
  • Knowledgeable of all Public Safety Policies and Procedures
  • Understand HIPAA and Patient confidentiality compliance
  • Demonstrates emergency preparedness knowledge

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Utilizes clear communication using professional telephone etiquette. Communicates effectively with management and coworkers on tasks, processes and procedures. Role models excellent, clear and professional communication skills to achieve mutual understanding and problem resolution, while providing the highest quality service during every patient, visitor and staff encounter.
  • Promotes a positive work environment and contributes to a dynamic, team focused work unit that actively helps one another to achieve optimal department results. Facilitates teamwork by anticipating the need for assistance and responding positively to requests for assistance. Makes contributions to the work effort as a whole. Contributes towards improvement of department scores for employee engagement, i.e. peer-to-peer accountability
  • Coordinates training, offers direction and develops skills of team members and continually assists with improving skills, performance and outcomes, orientation of department personnel. Monitors competency completion for onboarding hires, as appropriate.
  • Serves as the primary resource for staff in all areas of service that the department performs. Interfacing with department staff to provide feedback to management on team member’s performance and conduct. Collaborates/supports management for improvement of employee satisfaction, implementation of protocols and objectives with team members to result in optimization of staff performance, teamwork, patient safety, and customer service.
SERVICE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Secures premises and individuals by patrolling facilities; monitoring surveillance cameras and access points to permit authorized entry, ensuring all Security Officers do the same, as needed.
  • Responds to all radio dispatches as necessary, answers calls and complaints and assesses and makes recommendations as needed for all emergent situations. Leads and maintains high customer satisfaction while providing the highest level of safety and security to patients, visitors, staff and assets.
QUALITY/SAFETY ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Accurately communicates and/or generates and completes reports by recording occurrences, information, observations, surveillance activities and conducting witness interviews. Coordinates appropriate hand-off communication at change of shift.
  • Responds immediately to all emergency codes and takes action appropriately.
  • Maintains a safe environment, following all policies and procedures for safety, hazardous material, emergency preparedness and HIPAA. Reports accidents promptly and corrects minor safety hazards. Communicates with peers and management regarding any hazards identified in the workplace. Participates in training, drills and actual events according to policies and procedures.
  • Conducts quality audits and documents security systems checks to ensure proper functionality.
FINANCE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Prevents loss and damage by reporting irregularities, informing violators of policy and procedures.
  • Prioritizes daily tasks and provides leadership to team members on effective and efficient utilization of time, minimizing incidental overtime to achieve financial target and staffing needs.
  • Utilizes and maintains HM and department equipment according to manufacturer specifications. Uses resources efficiently.
GROWTH/INNOVATION ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Supports Houston Methodist and department goals and vision. Identifies and implements innovative solutions for practice or workflow changes to improve department operations. Implements actions that promote a workplace safety culture and proactively prevents workplace violence.
  • Assumes responsibility for self-growth and development by participating in in-services programs and continuing education. Participates on various council committee meetings, as requested. Ensures own career discussions occur with appropriate management. Completes and updates the My Development Plan on an on-going basis.

SUPPLEMENTAL REQUIREMENTS
WORK ATTIRE
  • Uniform: Yes
  • Scrubs: No
  • Business professional: No
  • Other (department approved): No
ON-CALL*

We are searching for a full-time night shift NCSO Security Officer -- someone who works well in a fast-paced setting. In this position, you will provide a safe and secure environment during the shift and within the area of the assigned post. The officer will assist the public, staff, and/or patients in all matters of safety and security. The security officer NCSO staffs a post as instructed and serves as a general security presence and visible deterrent to crime and client rule infractions; This position’s primary function is to assist with access control and visitor management into appropriate secure areas. This position documents the access through the visitor management system at their assigned post. The Security Officer NCSO also observes and reports any issues dealing with the safety and security of their assigned post to the Security upper leader.

Observes all persons entering and exiting the Hospital and/or assigned area of responsibility; Ensures that the required sign-in logs and documents are properly maintained as prescribed by departmental procedures

Trains for and responds to disaster situations in the hospital including visitor management functions, emergency lockdown, active patrol, de-escalations, security standbys, and other emergency job functions.

jobs.title: Overnight Security Guard
jobs.company: The Sam Houston Hotel, a Tapestry by Hilton
jobs.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic security team as a Security Guard and become the frontline protector of our facilities, assets, and personnel. In this vital role, you will ensure a safe and secure environment through vigilant surveillance, proactive patrols, and effective incident management. Your dedication will help maintain compliance with security regulations while providing exceptional customer service to visitors and staff alike. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your security expertise in a fast-paced, rewarding setting.

Duties

  • Conduct regular patrols of the premises to monitor for suspicious activity, unauthorized access, or safety hazards.
  • Operate access control systems to verify identities and regulate entry points for employees, visitors, and contractors.
  • Utilize CCTV surveillance equipment to monitor activity across the property and respond swiftly to any incidents or anomalies.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting security breaches, accidents, or other noteworthy events for record-keeping and follow-up.
  • Perform background checks on new employees or vendors as part of the onboarding process to ensure safety compliance.
  • Respond promptly to emergency situations by executing established procedures such as fire drills, medical emergencies, or conflict de-escalation.
  • Use physical security measures including heavy lifting, manual handling, and the deployment of tools like Tasers or firearms where legally permitted and trained.
  • Provide first aid assistance including CPR and AED operation when necessary to stabilize injured individuals until professional help arrives.
  • Enforce security policies in accordance with legal regulations and company standards while maintaining a professional demeanor at all times.
  • Support law enforcement agencies during investigations or incidents requiring external coordination.

Experience

  • Proven experience in security roles, law enforcement, military service, or related fields demonstrating strong situational awareness.
  • Familiarity with CCTV systems, access control technology, and emergency response procedures.
  • Certification in first aid, CPR, AED operation, and firearm handling preferred; training provided if necessary.
  • Ability to perform physical security tasks such as patrolling on foot or vehicle, heavy lifting, and manual handling with safety focus.
  • Skilled in incident report writing with attention to detail and clarity for legal or investigative purposes.
  • Strong conflict management skills with experience in de-escalation techniques to handle challenging situations professionally.
  • Knowledge of compliance standards related to security regulations and law enforcement protocols is highly desirable.

Join us in creating a safer environment where your vigilance makes a real difference!

Pay: $18.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Job Description

UpScale Security Services is hiring reliable and professional Unarmed Night Shift Security Guards for apartment communities in Houston & Surrounding Areas

These are standing post assignments focused on keeping residential properties safe, secure, and well-maintained during overnight hours. Officers will perform patrols, monitor for suspicious activity, secure amenities, and complete detailed electronic reports before the end of each shift.

Guards may be assigned to either property based on availability and client needs both sites are within the Houston metro area.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain a high-visibility presence throughout the property at night
  • Conduct routine patrols of parking lots, stairwells, and community areas
  • Ensure pools, gyms, and clubhouses are closed and secured after hours
  • Watch for trespassers, noise disturbances, or suspicious activity
  • Report any maintenance or safety issues (lighting, gates, etc.)
  • Complete clear, detailed electronic shift reports via the company’s app
  • Communicate professionally with residents and property staff

Requirements

  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Active Texas Level II (Unarmed) Security License required
  • U.S. Citizen or valid Work Authorization
  • Must pass background check and drug screening
  • Ability to stand and patrol for full 8-hour shifts
  • Dependable, punctual, and professional
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
